# sherpa-progress-step-tracker

A horizontal stepper.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Progress Steps |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-progress-step-tracker/sherpa-progress-step-tracker.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-progress-step-tracker/sherpa-progress-step-tracker.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-progress-step-tracker/sherpa-progress-step-tracker.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-progress-step-tracker/sherpa-progress-step-tracker.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-progress-step-tracker/sherpa-progress-step-tracker.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-progress-step-tracker data-current-step="2"></sherpa-progress-step-tracker>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-progress-step-tracker`:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Account"
  },
  {
    "label": "Plan",
    "description": "Pick one"
  },
  {
    "label": "Confirm"
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-current-step` | number |  | 0-based index of the active step |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | `Step[]` | read and write |  |
| `currentStep` | `number` | read and write |  |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `step-select` | `{ index: number; label: string }` |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`marker`, `step`, `steps`
